list: The official 55 trophies as published on PlayStation Network, verified 19-20 Nov 2026 against Exophase and PSNProfiles (the two agree on every name, description and grade). 1 platinum, 2 gold, 6 silver, 46 bronze; 28 hidden; 0 online trophies.
verified: Names, descriptions, grades and PSN progress targets checked against Exophase (exophase.com/game/grand-theft-auto-vi-psn/trophies) and PSNProfiles (psnprofiles.com/trophies/43531-grand-theft-auto-vi) on 19-20 Nov 2026. Method guidance is drawn from PowerPyx's trophy guide and 100% checklist guide (published 19 Nov 2026, played in the game); where PowerPyx says a method is still unknown, this guide says so too instead of guessing.

roadmap.title: Play the story
roadmap.text: Finish the five chapters and take optional missions as they appear. Scan new vehicles with the WAiNK app and study animals with binoculars as you go — that progress already counts toward 100% even though the checklist only appears after the story. Do the Chapter 1 meditation while you can: it is the one thing in the game that may be missable. Keep a manual save at the start and end of each chapter (15 manual slots; no mission replay). Source: PowerPyx trophy guide roadmap.

roadmap.title: 100% completion
roadmap.text: After the credits, the 100% checklist opens under Progress > Stats > 100% Completion: 35 lines in three groups. Most lines need only part of a set (200 of 277 vehicles, 100 of 255 animals, 70 of 80 challenges); only robberies, underwater discoveries, shooting ranges, drone races and Bret's quests need everything. Nothing on the checklist is missable — all of it can be done in free roam after the story. Source: PowerPyx trophy guide and 100% checklist guide.

roadmap.title: Strangers & cleanup
roadmap.text: Finish the 8 Strangers & Freaks strands and the character questlines, then sweep up whatever miscellaneous trophies are left. By now most of the list should already be done from the 100% work. Source: PowerPyx trophy guide roadmap.

roadmap.title: Platinum
roadmap.text: Vice Got a Price! pops the moment the other 54 are earned. PowerPyx rates the whole set 4/10 difficulty and about 200 hours in a single playthrough, with no online trophies and no difficulty settings. Source: PowerPyx trophy guide.

warnings: Cheats disable trophies and saving — keep them off for the whole run. Source: PowerPyx trophy guide.
There is no mission replay and no New Game+. The game has 15 manual save slots plus one autosave; PowerPyx recommends a save at the start and end of each chapter. Source: PowerPyx trophy guide.
Only one trophy may be missable: Positive Mental Attitude, because of a meditation in Chapter 1. Everything else can be finished in free roam after the story. Source: PowerPyx trophy guide.

sources.name: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies (counts)
KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies and this one pops on its own. No multiplayer and no DLC is needed. PowerPyx rates the full set 4/10 difficulty and about 200 hours in one playthrough, with no online trophies and no difficulty settings to worry about.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: A story trophy that cannot be missed. It unlocks when you finish the opening mission, Gone Fishing, in Chapter 1.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: A story trophy that cannot be missed. It pops when Chapter 1 ends — PowerPyx reports it unlocks with the first mission of Chapter 2, What's in the Bag?

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: A story trophy that cannot be missed. It pops when Chapter 2 ends — PowerPyx reports it unlocks with the first mission of Chapter 3, Welcome to Vice City.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: A story trophy that cannot be missed. It pops when Chapter 3 ends — PowerPyx reports it unlocks after the first two missions of Chapter 4, Ocean Beach and Another Life.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: A story trophy that cannot be missed. PowerPyx reports it pops with the final mission of Chapter 4, Starting From Zero.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: A story trophy that cannot be missed. Finish the final mission — PowerPyx reports it is Starting From Zero, the same mission that closes Chapter 4.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: A story trophy that cannot be missed. It unlocks during the Chapter 2 mission Breakfast Run — just play the mission through.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: A story trophy that cannot be missed. It unlocks during the Chapter 3 mission The Cartel Heist — just play the mission through.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: A story trophy that cannot be missed. It unlocks during the Chapter 4 mission Child's Play — just play the mission through.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: A story trophy that cannot be missed. It unlocks during the Chapter 4 mission Headliners — just play the mission through.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: A story trophy that cannot be missed. It unlocks during the Chapter 4 mission VCIA Takedown — just play the mission through.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: A story trophy that cannot be missed. It unlocks during the Chapter 5 mission Operation Savage Glory — just play the mission through.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% on the in-game checklist, which opens after the story under Progress > Stats > 100% Completion — but everything you do during the story already counts. The checklist has 35 lines in three groups, and most need only part of a set: 200 of 277 vehicles, 100 of 255 animals, 70 of 80 challenges. Only robberies, underwater discoveries, shooting ranges, drone races and Bret's quests need everything. Nothing on the checklist is missable, so all of it can be finished in free roam after the credits. PowerPyx calls it the hardest trophy, but notes the requirements are closer to 60% true completion than a real 100%.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete any 250 of the 397 stunts in Leonida — 100% completion needs 300, so keep going past this trophy if you are chasing A Long Road. There are four kinds: 130 stunt jumps, 202 flights under bridges, 40 knife flights between buildings and 25 base jumps, and you can mix them freely. PowerPyx calls the under-bridge flights the quickest to do. Track progress by region in Progress > Activities > Stunts, or on the map under Exploration > Stunt Spots.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once. View them in Touchpad > Progress > Activities. PowerPyx lists the nine as fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool, basketball, playing a video game, winning a car race (or race challenge, or Top Fun drone race) and performing a stunt. The story introduces most of them for you, and the rest are marked with blue icons when you unfog the map — you will almost certainly finish this naturally while working on the other trophies.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. PowerPyx's guide covers all 12 shooting range locations and every gold medal; the two ranges named in its 100% checklist guide are Griffin Shooting Range and Rodgers Ranch. Gold medals are also one of the few 100% checklist lines with no slack — all 42 are needed for A Long Road, so this trophy comes free on the way there.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at every location — 14 locations, 42 races in total. PowerPyx's guide lists all 14 locations. Drone races are also one of the 100% checklist lines with no slack, so you will need every location for A Long Road anyway.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. PowerPyx's guide lists all 40 unique race locations, so there is plenty of choice — pick the short ones and repeat the ones you are good at. Winning a race also counts as one of the 9 activity types for Master of None.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: After the Chapter 1 mission Feng Shui, where you meet Cal, he will text you a fishing location marked with a purple icon on the map. Follow Cal's fishing questline and beat him in a fishing challenge.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete one arcade game — the in-game 'Video Games'. There are four: Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III, Time Jackers Rewind and Bang For Your Buck. The first three are playable on the TV at home from Chapter 1 by interacting with the controllers; Bang For Your Buck is on arcade machines around the world. You must finish all the levels of one game at least once, but you do not need to beat all of its challenges — pick whichever you like best.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Andy's optional questline is exclusive to Lucia and gets marked automatically in Chapter 3: Andy calls, then texts her home address, which marks the questline in Belville. Complete her five quests — Climbing the Cellerichain (Parts 1-3), Pay the Cellerica Fee, Peach!, Read the Label and Puff Puff Pass — and the trophy pops with the last one. All of her quests are still available after the story.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Kenton's optional questline is marked automatically in Chapter 1, a while after the mission Island Dreams where you work for him. He calls, then appears as the green KR icon in Key Lento. His quests are treasure-diving runs: he marks purple treasure-chest icons on the map, you find the underwater treasure — a metal detector digs it from the ocean floor — and bring it back. Seven shipwrecks in total. Track it in Progress > Characters > Kenton Rees. Kenton goes quiet for a stretch in Chapters 2-3 but comes back, so the questline is not missable.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Billy's optional questline is marked automatically after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, at the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County. Complete his five quests — Thrillbillies, Twist Wrist Smash Grab, Mall Rats, The Impaler and Hometown Heroes — and the trophy pops with the last one. All of his quests are still available after the story.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers — but only certain questlines count. PowerPyx warns that Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy and Eddie do NOT count toward this trophy. Confirmed counting strands are Kirk (the Skunk Ape hunts: Skunk Apeology 101, tree effigies, Advanced Skunk Apeonomics), Kyle (McKittrick Farm), Yago (street racing and mentoring) and Pilot Pete (plane recovery and deliveries) — and PowerPyx notes more strangers are still being found. Track your count in the trophy list, and leave this for the post-story cleanup: every stranger is still there in free roam.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Randy's questline, Randy's Wish List, is marked automatically after the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS, where you steal the Zorrusso for him and unlock the Key Cloner. He then wants 16 sports cars delivered to his garage (green RK icon, west Vice City). He marks some cars for you in fixed locations, but you can steal them off the street too — scan a car with the WAiNK app to see if it is on the list, and deliver it in good condition for more money. Track the list under Map > Robberies > Randy's Wish List. It can all be done after the story.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Tyrone's optional questline is only available as Jason and is marked automatically after the Chapter 3 mission Here, Kitty Kitty. Purple markers show the Synthetic Labs in Vice City — go and destroy them as part of the quest Take Out Kitty Litter. Once enough labs are down, Tyrone gives his second quest, Spin On This, to shut the labs down, and the trophy pops with it. All of it is still available after the story.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.missableNote: Potentially missable — see the guide. The only trophy any guide flags as possibly missable.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 spots across 10 locations. Meditating with both Jason and Lucia at the same spot counts as +2, so bring your partner. Track progress in Progress > Collections > Exploration > Meditations. THE MISSABLE ONE: one meditation can only be done in Chapter 1 at Jason's house. After the mission Down to Earth, talk to Lucia in the kitchen in the morning — she says she is going to meditate, walks to the balcony, and you follow her and choose Accept. That meditation raises the counter by 1 but is not marked as a spot like the rest, so PowerPyx says it is still unclear whether it is required for the trophy. Do it anyway, and keep a manual save from the start of Chapter 1. You cannot do the last meditation until both characters can play together, after Chapter 2's Coffee Break.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Bret Vogel's optional questline is exclusive to Jason and is marked at some point after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, when Bret texts you. His first quest, Veteran Hunted, is in Lummox County; after it he marks hunting spots with purple icons, and you hunt the animals he requests and bring them to him. On the first quest he gives you the unique hunting rifle Killtelligence SM-69, retrievable from any weapon locker at Ammu-Nations. Track his quests under Map > Activities > Target Deck — there are 15 Target Decks and all of them are needed for 100% completion, so this trophy should come naturally. PowerPyx notes it is still being confirmed which exact animal pops the trophy.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 collectible card sets. PowerPyx's guide lists all 18 card set locations across Leonida — pick the three easiest sets to finish first. Note that 100% completion needs far more of the sets than this trophy does, so keep collecting after it pops; PowerPyx's 100% checklist guide has the exact count.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Scan 100 locations with the WAiNK app (hold Up, then R1). There are far more than 100 scannable spots, so any 100 count: PowerPyx breaks them down as 31 landmarks, 35 curiosities, 23 sculptures and the No Flusher tags. Scan as you travel and this will finish on its own.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 of the 80 challenges. 100% completion needs any 70 of 80, so this trophy pops on the way to A Long Road. View and track them under Progress > Challenges. Most will complete naturally while you work on the other trophies — leave this for late cleanup, then pick the easiest and quickest of the ones you have left.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, lose a 4-star wanted level and escape the heat. This is only possible once you can free-roam together, after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break. Call your partner (hold Right, then Triangle), cause enough carnage to reach 4 stars, then escape on a fast sports motorcycle — PowerPyx recommends driving through the train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County, where cops struggle to follow and the helicopter cannot see you. The trophy pops when you drive out of the red heat zone, not when you leave the flashing blue search area. It also pops automatically while you rob the large bank vaults for 100% completion, which always trigger 4-star wanted levels.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your wanted level. Same unlock point as Hot Together — after Chapter 2's Coffee Break. Keep the red/blue flashing wanted level (not the red heat level) the whole time: equip an armored vest and sticky bombs from Ammu-Nation and carry Zombix or Adrenaline for healing. Call your partner, then loot 3 shops in a row; the pop is delayed by about half a minute after leaving the third shop. PowerPyx suggests the 3 jewelry stores in north Vice City, available after Chapter 3's Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs — rob a couple of items in each store and break the back-room safe with sticky bombs. If it does not pop after the third shop, hit a fourth and keep going.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Use the WAiNK app from your phone (hold Up to open it instantly), look at a vehicle and hold R1 to scan it — scanning is enough, you do not need to drive it. The quickest way is to stand on a busy road and scan everything that passes. There are 557 vehicles at launch, and 100% completion needs 200 of the 277 base models scanned, so this trophy comes automatically. Check your totals in Touchpad > Progress > Vehicles.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus (L3 + R3 while aiming a firearm). Combat Focus slows time and highlights vulnerable spots, but drains the purple focus bar and only lasts a few seconds. Buff your focus first with food, drinks or Adrenaline, then line up 5 enemies — criminals at gang operations are a good spot — and drop them quickly with an assault rifle like the Duke 556. PowerPyx notes it does not seem to work on soldiers, police or civilians, and that wearing body armor helps you get close. Focus has 4 levels, raised by shooting ranges, golf, pool, fishing and headshots, so this gets easier late in the game and may pop naturally.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Steal one of the large passenger planes docked at a departure terminal at VCIA (Vice City International Airport). It must be a plane connected to a boarding bridge — the ones parked on the airfield do not work. Easiest is the plane at departure terminals E3/E4: drive through a fence around the airfield, head to the plane, use the stairs next to the boarding bridge to get inside, go upstairs to the cockpit, reverse the plane to the airstrip and take off. Fly 1 km (0.6 miles) away from the airport and the trophy pops — the unlock is slightly delayed.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Steal a military tank — a Rhino — at Mile Zero Air Station, the island on the south-west edge of the map in Mariana County. The tanks stand in the south of the air base; drive through the gate or take the stunt jump next to the south-east entrance. Climb in and shoot some enemies until the trophy pops.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. First finish the Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs, which unlocks the Snap Gun for silently lockpicking alarmed doors and marks jewelry store robberies with green icons. Enter through the back door with the Snap Gun — kicking the door triggers the alarm. In the back room, find the note with the safe code, loot the safe, destroy the security footage and disable the alarm. The trophy pops shortly after you leave the store. PowerPyx suggests Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape. First finish the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is… — it is marked automatically from story progress and teaches vault robbery: tail a security van until it stops at a bank, then slip in while the vault is open and rob it. Bring your partner, because you cannot carry all the cash alone. After that quest you can pay Yasmani $10,000 per tip to mark security vans (finish his earlier quests, robbing 2 payday loans, first). There are 8 large bank jobs in total and 100% completion needs all 8, so this pops on the way. Every vault robbery triggers a 4-star wanted level — escape on a fast motorcycle, then switch vehicles to become unrecognizable. A single vault can pay up to $205,000, making this the best money in the endgame.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. It pops automatically in the same Chapter 4 mission that unlocks bank vaults, That's Where The Money Is… — robbing the vault of a large bank counts as robbing the armored truck that delivered the cash. If you want it earlier, block an armored truck driving near a bank, plant a sticky bomb on its back door and blow it up, then escape the red heat radius. Sticky bombs are in the back of Yasmani's shop after his quests. 100% completion needs all 8 large bank jobs, so this comes free either way.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida — fully unfog the whole map across all 52 areas. The fastest way is by plane: fly over every area still covered in black fog until the entire map is visible. PowerPyx's guide to unfogging the map fast names the best plane for the job.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. There are 39 illegal gang operations in total, and 100% completion needs all 39 — so this trophy pops early on the way there. Operations are marked by yellow icons on the map when you go near them, and many are marked automatically from story progress. Track each gang's count in Progress > Gangs.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Go to the Ocean View Rooftop Bar on Ocean Beach, buy an Apple Martini and drink it while standing next to the bar, looking out at the view. That is the whole trophy — a quiet moment, not a mission.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Steal a specific car from a specific showroom and drive it through the showroom window. The car is the blue Banshee in the vehicle showroom in the south of Vice City. You can only steal it after obtaining the Key Cloner in the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' Gs — hack into the car, drive forward and straight through the window. The pop is slightly delayed and comes after you drive further away on the street. Only the blue Banshee counts; it is an easter egg nod to the Banshee from GTA III.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: At Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn — one of the illegal gang operations — steal all 3 key valuables: the luxury watch in the south-east office, the unique shotgun variant Gutterball Moreland 850 on the table in the north-east corner, and the safe in the north-east hallway, which you blow open with sticky bombs (buy them at an Ammu-Nation first). The trophy pops after you escape the police, not when you pick up the third item, and killing the enemies is not necessary. You first go there in the Chapter 2 optional mission Hit Kingpin Bowling, but the trophy is not missable: if you miss an item, wait for the robbery icon to respawn and go back for the rest.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Have maximum strength with both Jason and Lucia at the same time. Check strength in Touchpad > Jason & Lucia > Strength (the heart icon). This is only possible after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, when you can switch between both characters. Raise strength by working out — buy a membership at a fitness club (filter for them on Map > Activities) and always go together with your partner: while one character actively works out, the other completes their training too, so you make double progress. You can also work out at home after the story.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Perform 500 actions that affect your criminal profile. Turn on criminal-profile notifications (Settings > UI > HUD Notifications > Criminal Profile = On) so you see a small demon face on the right of the screen whenever something counts. The profiles run Professional (finishing objectives and robberies stealthily, destroying evidence, clean escapes), Hardened (incapacitating enemies without killing them), Violent (killing enemies and civilians), Psycho (killing large numbers of cops and civilians, or driving over gravestones) and Irredeemable — a permanent status from excessive violence, which PowerPyx warns against because cops become more aggressive. This happens passively across robberies and fights, so do not chase it early; if it is your last trophy, it can be farmed quickly, but that pushes your profile toward Psycho or Irredeemable.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: No verified method exists yet. PowerPyx lists this trophy as currently unknown, believed to be related to the Payday Loans store from the prologue. The description — 'Second time's the charm' — suggests succeeding at something after a first failure. This guide will not invent a method: check PowerPyx's trophy guide for updates once players have pinned it down.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Complete the UFO easter egg. At night after 2 AM, go alone to the road north-west of Starlet Motel in Kelly County. If a blinking car is parked at the roadside, follow the path into the woods toward the UFO's bright blue light in the sky. Approach it and the UFO drops a woman it abducted — talk to her, offer to help, and go back to her car at the roadside. The spawn is slightly random and not guaranteed: if the blinking car is not there, drive away and come back.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: No verified method exists yet. PowerPyx lists this trophy as currently unknown, believed to be from kicking enemies while driving a motorcycle. The description — a melee drive-by that bowls someone over — fits a drive-by melee knockdown from a bike. This guide will not invent a method: check PowerPyx's trophy guide for updates once players have pinned it down.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder $250,000 in marked bills through your contacts. First finish the Chapter 3 mission Credit Check, which unlocks the Dye Pack Jammer you need to launder marked bills. Then rob banks and payday loans and bring the marked bills to a fence — Yasmani in Vice City pays the most. The total counts across all robberies, so you do not need $250,000 at once. Bank vaults pay up to $205,000 in a single robbery, and 100% completion needs the same robberies anyway, so this comes naturally.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend a total of $100,000 across all types of shops. Guns, car mods and tattoos are the fastest way there — they are the most expensive things in the game. Leonida has 24 Ammu-Nations, 14 mod shops, 19 Pay 'n' Sprays, 67 clothing stores, 17 footwear stores, 18 hair and beauty salons, 11 tattoo studios and 15 electronics stores, so you will not run out of places to spend.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all 8 purchasable garages — there are 4 more garages that come from the story, which do not count. The 8 cost $160,000 in total. They become available after the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver, when the Vice City Real Estate app is installed on your phone; buy them through the app. The quickest money is robberies, especially the higher-value ones that open in Chapters 3 and 4.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. The app is installed on your phone after the Chapter 2 mission Moses, which also unlocks Moses himself. You need enough garages first — see Little Boxes — because each garage adds parking spots to register more vehicles. Then drive stolen vehicles to Moses in Port Gellhorn, and in his garage choose Respray and then Register. At first he only accepts vehicles without trackers; from Chapter 3 you can also register cars with standard trackers at any Pay 'n' Spray. Registration costs money, so use cheap low-end cars and bikes.
